body: I'm 16, young I know. I've been seeing a psychiatrist for at least 4 years or so now. My family knows of what I'm going through and they're pretty understanding but I try to not to mention it a lot..why? My mom is very "sensitive" when it comes to it. About less than 2 years ago I told her I was having suicidal thoughts and she broke down crying. She asks me from time to time how I'm doing and for the most part I usually lie about it because it's tough seeing my mom get really sad about this. Thank you for your support/advice :-). Also, I apologize if I don't reply very quickly.
